Thessalonians that would be published the following year in the journal for the study of the New Testament this image does not come directly from Paul's

in my opinion the British New Testament conference leans a little conservatively so this is not the most rigorous data
that are possible but it enables us to get a bit of a toe hold as you can see if you can read it for Romans first and
second Corinthians Galatians and first Thessalonians all 109 Scholars said yes Paul wrote this epistle for Philippians
all but one said yes and that one said no for Philemon all but one said yes and that once that they were uncertain for
Hebrews not a single scholar said that Paul wrote it for Ephesians a plurality of Scholars said Paul did not write it
and and a majority could not attribute authorship to Paul for Colossians and 4 2 Thessalonians a majority of Scholars
said yes Paul did write this epistle and that brings us to the Pastoral Epistles first in second Timothy and Titus fewer
than 25 percent of Scholars could attribute authorship to Paul and about 56 percent of Scholars on average across
the three Epistles said no Paul did not write this so I would call that a pretty good consensus that Paul was not the
